energyDecayCurve.definition: remaining exact sum of squared PCM samples from each 10 ms block to observed render end divided by total observed energy; render endpoint is preserved without padding or forced zero

decay.terminalSilenceNote: No exact silent 50 ms window persisted to the observed render end.
